result.summary: The home screen is mostly polished, but several cards and chips are clipped by the viewport, and one restaurant name is truncated, which hurts scanability.

issues.description: The last cuisine chip ('Healthy') and the last 'Fastest near you' card are cut off at the right edge, so users cannot see the full filter or restaurant.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/insets and show a peek of the next item, or allow the carousels to scroll fully into view without clipping.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word on the last fastest card.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, slightly smaller type, or a fade/ellipsis so the full name remains readable.

issues.description: The bottom popular restaurant card (pizza, -20%) is cropped by the tab bar, hiding most of the listing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The search field placeholder is very light gray on a light background, which reduces readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color to meet contrast guidelines while keeping it distinct from entered text.
